patch_resolves_note: The bundled patch directly adds `Codepoint() : _highSurrogate(0) {}` in `src/ArduinoJson/Json/Utf16.hpp`. The fixed instrumented execution reaches the same low-surrogate witness path and records a 2-byte initialized prefix for `codepoint._highSurrogate` at the root and append events, plus a 2-byte initialized prefix for `codepoint16` at the sink, where the vulnerable run records 0 in both places.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: First project-level consumer on the vulnerable path. `parseVariant()` reads byte `0x27` from the staged witness, dispatches to the quoted-string case, and with `filter.allowValue()` true routes control into `parseStringValue()` / `parseQuotedString()`.

This stack allocation instantiates `Utf16::Codepoint` without a constructor in the vulnerable revision, so `codepoint._highSurrogate` starts indeterminate until some earlier high-surrogate append writes it.
MSAN crash site. `encodeCodepoint()` branches on `codepoint16`, which is derived from the poisoned `codepoint32` value built from the uninitialized `_highSurrogate` state.

At `_codepoint = uint32_t(0x10000 + ((_highSurrogate << 10) | (codeunit & 0x3FF)));`, the low-surrogate branch reads the 2-byte `_highSurrogate` field even though none of those bytes are initialized on the vulnerable witness.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `append_low_surrogate_mix.high_surrogate_read_bytes=2` and `append_low_surrogate_mix.high_surrogate_initialized_prefix_len=0` at the low-surrogate combine.

edges.description: The exact stack `Utf16::Codepoint` object allocated as `codepoint` in `parseQuotedString()` is the same object whose `this` pointer enters the low-surrogate `append()` call.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `quoted_string_codepoint_root.codepoint_object_ptr == append_low_surrogate_mix.codepoint_this_ptr == 0x7ffe47ee5a20`; the fixed trace records the same equality for its own stack object address.

edges.description: The `_codepoint` value computed in the low-surrogate `append()` branch is forwarded unchanged as the `codepoint32` argument into `Utf8::encodeCodepoint()`.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `append_low_surrogate_mix.codepoint_value_bits == encode_codepoint_sink.codepoint32_bits == 23773679`; the fixed trace records the same equality with value `66031`.
